Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Antique Treasures Gallery specializes in the sale of vintage and collectible items, focusing on furniture, artwork, and decorative pieces sourced from various eras. Our operations emphasize a commitment to authenticity and quality, with each item carefully curated and appraised. We maintain robust accounting practices and anti-fraud measures to ensure transparency in our transactions. Our knowledgeable staff provides detailed histories and valuations for our inventory, fostering trust and confidence among our clientele. Our store features a secure environment with dedicated monitoring systems in place to protect our valuable stock.

– Demonstrated low frequency of slip-and-fall claims, indicating effective safety protocols
such as adequate floor maintenance, signage, and employee training.
